summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Apollo shot in the left eye and Heracles in the right during the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ephialtes among the Giants destroyed when Heracles fought at the gods' side: Apollo shot him with an arrow in his left eye and Heracles in his right. The oracle that the gods needed a mortal's help concerns the Giants together; Ephialtes is one of those named in the battle roll.
This Ephialtes is not the Aload who with his brother Otus piled Ossa on Olympus.
